catalogue.name: The Orders of the Rebublic
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Congress doctrine
sharedRules.description:
» You must have an Order Command choice. You may select any allied force command choice of max Wounds(2) as your second command choice.
» You have the same limitations/bonuses as your allied force doctrine, but not its faction powers.
» You may not use upgrades from your allied force list. However, your allied force units may receive Order upgrades.
» Order core choices allows you to field Order special units, allied core choices allow you to field allied special choices. You may not field more than twice as many order core choices as allied core choices, or vice versa. Example: you field two order or allied core choices. You may field 1-4 of the other.

Allied force: none
Spend one (1) Faction Point:

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● This is who we are: all attacks versus one (1) enemy unit have Loathing until end of game.
● We know their tricks: Use in the initiative phase. Until end of turn, cancel any enemy FP use on 4+.
● Emergency measures: use during force generation. You may field 1x core unit from the Republic, Chamber, Primary Chamber, Faithful, Grey or Mercenaries force list. You may spend an additional FP to field a special unit instead.
